theme: 人与自然、生态文明与宜居城市 (Ecology, Environment & Urban Habitat)
description: 考研英语一常考母题——人与自然和谐共生、绿色低碳生活、城市口袋公园宜居建设、遏制环境恶化深度论据素材库

sub_themes.name: 人与自然和谐共生与宜居城市 (Coexistence with Nature & Livable Cities)

core_vocabulary.collocation: advance the construction of ecological civilization (推进生态文明建设)
strive for harmonious coexistence between humans and nature (追求人与自然和谐共生)
the proliferation of accessible pocket parks (便民口袋公园的普及)
enhance urban livability and citizen contentment (提高城市宜居度和市民满意度)
expand green ecological footprints (扩大绿色生态足迹)
chart a course of sustainable green development (开辟可持续绿色发展道路)

proverbs_and_quotes.quote: Lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets.
proverbs_and_quotes.author: Xi Jinping (绿色发展理念：绿水青山就是金山银山)
proverbs_and_quotes.translation: 绿水青山就是金山银山。
proverbs_and_quotes.usage: 用于中国生态文明建设、人与自然关系论证

proverbs_and_quotes.quote: Nature does not need people; people need nature.
proverbs_and_quotes.author: Conservation International Motto
proverbs_and_quotes.translation: 大自然不需要人类；人类却离不开大自然。
proverbs_and_quotes.usage: 用于论述保护生态环境归根到底是在守护人类自身的生存家园

argument_points.point_en: Urban modernization is measured not merely by towering concrete skyscrapers, but by the accessible greenery that allows citizens to breathe fresh air and unwind within walking distance.
argument_points.point_cn: 城市现代化的衡量标尺不仅在于林立的钢筋水泥摩天楼，更在于步行可达的葱郁绿意让市民得以呼吸新鲜空气、纾解身心。

argument_points.point_en: Sacrificing environmental sustainability for ephemeral economic gain is an act of draining the pond to catch all the fish, leaving irreparable debts for posterity.
argument_points.point_cn: 以牺牲环境可持续性为代价换取短暂经济利益无异于竭泽而渔，将给子孙后代留下难以弥补的生态亏欠。

sample_sentence_patterns: The increasing presence of pocket parks and urban green belts vividly mirrors our societal shift from purely pursuing GDP growth to prioritizing human-centric well-being.
Only when environmental preservation is deeply woven into the fabric of urban planning can modern metropolises flourish as hospitable habitats for both body and soul.
